get.description:
Plain-English search ("kids playing in snow"), best matches first. Falls back to keyword search
when the AI extras aren't installed or no photo has been analysed yet.

post.description: Remove from the library (a tombstone). The original stays in S3; restore brings it back.

get.description: Every original that has been requested, newest first (for a 'Requested originals' list).
Does every device that has synced hold the same library? (Uses each device's last registry entry.)

put.description: A phone publishes its on-device catalog (gzip body). Checked, then stored in S3 for others.

get.description: The run in progress on this Mac, if any (started here or from the terminal).
Server-sent events: everything the run has logged so far, then new lines as they arrive.
Uploads that are complete but not archived yet, and recent results.

post.description: Try again with uploads whose archive failed (they stay in the inbox until they succeed).
A fresh code (shoebox pair calls this on the running server).
